need.title: SWFWMD watering restrictions through Mar 31 2027 — Oct 1 did not lift
need.body: Oct 2 TownSq update: Oct 1 was not the lift date. Restrictions continue through March 31, 2027. No change to the rules themselves. Lawn and landscape watering once per week, midnight–4am or 8pm–11:59pm unless the county has stricter hours. Hand-watering or micro-irrigation of plants other than lawns 6pm–8am. New lawns and plants: 60-day establishment (days 1–30 any day 6pm–8am; days 31–60 three days a week). 12-month rainfall deficit through August 2026 is 15.4 inches. Applies to Sarasota County. HOA, Sunnygrove, and Pulte are reviewing which replacement zones legally qualify for grow-in irrigation (over 50% replacement); other areas wait until restrictions lift. Landscape inquiries: sunnygrovemaintenance.com/?assoc=7370.

need.title: LSV golf carts — county road rules
need.body: Sarasota County: LSVs only on roads posted 35 mph or less. Licensed/registered carts may use E Manasota Beach Rd to cross 776. Register every BeachWalk cart with the HOA before use.
